title: Lifeline
description: This is the OFFICIAL "Lifeline" series mod
body:
Season one of the Lifeline series is beginning soon! Members (and followers of the series) can get a copy of the _OFFICIAL_ mod here on Modrinth!

This mod supports Minecraft Fabric 1.21

**Commands**

**/start** - Starts the season off by giving the members their lives and their Lifeline.

**/pause** - Pauses the session and freezes everyone's life count.

**/stop** - Ends the game early.
